column1: # Super Mario Sunshine in Super Mario 3D All-Stars (program 2 of application 010049900F546000; update 1.1.4 = v393216), SDK 9.5.1.
# NERD's Hagi layer: the GameCube's PowerPC code statically recompiled to arm64 in an LZ4-packed NRO (data/gekko/MarioSunshine/nx/MarioSunshine.nrolz, collected by nro_collect.py,
# loaded with nn::ro). Renders with Vulkan (dm/gfx/vk/hle_vk.m), shaders captured at run time on the Mac. Packed one program at a time: the NSP script's --program 2
# Hagi: a 3D game pad (D-pad, right stick)
# Hagi (hagi.config): the Wii pointer is the touch screen in handheld mode
# not loaded, main takes nothing from them the host does not supply: subsdk1 (NintendoSDK_OpenGL), subsdk2 (NintendoSDK_Vulkan)
# The NPDM declares 8 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main sets a heap of 3.08 GB (SetHeapSize 0xc5400000): a 3.125 GB heap region.
# Hagi's Memory.Initialize reserves a 4 GB + 2 MB address region for the GameCube memory (nn::os::AllocateAddressRegion), and its fiber scheduler then reserves 1 GB for the fiber
# stacks (main+0x151218). The SDK's AddressRegionManager keeps the first 0x3fe00000 of the alias region as its node area and aligns a region of 1 GB or more to 1 GB, so the two regions
# take 0x80000000-0x180200000 and 0x1c0000000-0x200000000 of the alias region: 8 GB. Without the second the scheduler never creates the CPU fiber and switches to an empty context
# (a crash at main+0x15ec0c). The block is 256 MB in front + 8 GB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 3.25 GB heap region
